title: Waddles / data plane (ingest, process, action)
description: Rust data-plane stages: svc-ingest, svc-process, svc-action and the egress proxy. Scraped from /metrics (:9090); svc-ingest EventSub latency is the only per-event latency histogram emitted today.

panels.title: Stages up
panels.description: Running replicas reporting an *_up gauge (ingest + process + action).

targets.expr: (sum(svc_ingest_up) or vector(0)) + (sum(svc_process_up) or vector(0)) + (sum(svc_action_up) or vector(0))

panels.title: Events published / s
panels.description: Normalized platform events XADDed onto the spine.

panels.title: Publish error ratio
panels.description: svc_ingest_publish_errors_total over attempted publishes.

panels.title: Consumer loops down
panels.description: Spine consumer/receiver loops currently disconnected or retrying (0 is healthy).

targets.expr: (count(svc_ingest_consumer_loop_running == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(svc_process_consumer_loop_running == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(svc_action_consumer_loop_running == 0) or vector(0))

panels.title: Executors connected
panels.description: Bundle-executor sessions held by each stage (svc-process / svc-action).

panels.title: Dead-lettered (no executor), 1h
panels.description: Dispatch entries dead-lettered because no executor connection existed.

panels.title: Receiver connection healthy
panels.description: 1 healthy, 0 = fatal non-retryable close stopped that platform's reconnect loop (process keeps running).

panels.title: EventSub verification outcomes
panels.description: ok vs bad_signature / replay_rejected / secret_not_found / missing_header / bad_content_type / oversized_body.

panels.title: EventSub handler latency p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Webhook fast-path latency (Twitch requires an answer within 10 s).

panels.title: Spine connect attempts by receiver
panels.description: Every connect-retry increments; a sustained non-zero rate means a receiver is stuck retrying.

panels.title: Consumer spawn / stop transitions
panels.description: A flapping binding shows up as continuous spawn/stop churn.

panels.title: Consumer groups created
panels.description: XGROUP CREATE (not BUSYGROUP) by the self-heal / startup provisioning step.

panels.title: Change-log lag
panels.description: safe_seq - last_seq after the latest poll: how far the active-set loader trails hub-api's change log.

panels.title: Change-log gaps / retention exceeded / stale evictions
panels.description: Each forces a full authoritative reconcile.

panels.title: Per-scope read / resolve failures
panels.description: read_failed is the database-connectivity signal for the active-set loader.

panels.title: Failures - bundle load and executor link
Active-set rows excluded (top 10 app/reason)
panels.description: An active bundle silently going dark (approval expired, digest missing).

panels.title: Dial latency p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Validate + resolve + dial the upstream.

panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status.

panels.title: svc-ingest p99 latency
panels.description: Request duration p99, all routes.

panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status.
